every_recorded_compose_comparison_is_ans.comment: The Compose upgrade comparison of ops/ansible/tasks/runtime-upgrade-preflight.yml at dbfec38e, as recorded by a scratch recorder: the installed and the candidate Compose were POSIX shell stand-ins that answered each invocation from the case and logged its arguments and the PATH, LC_ALL and DOCKER_HOST it was given; the program ran under the interpreter named here with only the installed Compose's path replaced by its stand-in and its 20 second deadline by 2 (an answer marked sleep takes 5). A pad answer is the text followed by spaces up to the byte count given. Its exit status, output and the invocations were kept. Each case is bound to the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON description.
